Privacy Policy

The Fashion PAWty collects as little personal information as possible: nothing at all unless you email us, buy a ticket through Stripe, or accept analytics cookies.

What information do we collect?

If you email us at team@eyespy.org, we receive your email address and whatever you choose to share. Ticket and sponsorship payments are processed entirely by Stripe on Stripe's servers — we never see or store your card details. With your consent, we use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the site.

How do we use cookies and analytics?

Analytics scripts load only after you accept the consent banner. Declining loads zero third-party scripts. You can change your choice anytime by clearing this site's data in your browser and revisiting.

How can you contact us about privacy?

Email team@eyespy.org with any privacy question or request (access, correction, deletion). We aim to respond within two business days.

Last updated: July 20, 2026.
